cues.note: Open-air deck wind under the hook. Same bed returns at the seam.
Metallic tick as the penny tips off the ledge, on the word penny.
Air rush begins on Dropped. Pitch stays flat once speed locks at 25 mph.
A thin, unreal whoosh under the no-air 200 mph readout. Not the real fall.
The 2.0 s silent rush. Louder air, street noise rising. No voice.
Dry knock on a scalp. The word Bonk is spoken; this is the picture hit, not a second voice.
Lighter tick as the coin leaves the head.
Fingertips on hair while he scratches.
Wind returns as the camera climbs. Match 0.0 at the seam.
